errors.evidence: Description states 7.0 in 2011 for men, but the figure shows it starts at approximately 6.9.
Description states 7.2 in 2018 for men, but the figure shows it remains around 7.0.
Description states it sinks to 6.8 in 2019 for men, but the figure shows it is approximately 6.7.
Description states it reaches 6.6 in 2021 for men, but the figure shows it is approximately 6.7.
Description states it sinks to 6.7 in 2019 for women, but the figure shows it is approximately 7.0.
Description states it reaches 6.3 in 2021 for women, but the figure shows it is approximately 6.5.
The description does not mention that error bars are present for both men and women.
